claims_forbidden: any statement beyond the tested fixture/model
analysis_method.paired_view: per pair: which layers each arm reached; where they diverge, the raw args and sink entries decide
analysis_method.per_arm_table: each arm: canonical_integration_valid count, per-layer reach counts, observables counts, token totals
analysis_method.statistical_testing: none — 4 pairs cannot support significance; no p-values, no rates, no generalization

control.instructions_sha256_bound_at_pair_time: captured and pinned per pair by the INPUT_IDENTITY gate

treatment.schema: SupervisorIntegrationDecisionV2 (frozen, unchanged — byte-identical, see consistency report)

data_integrity.historical_payloads: RCA-2A.4 artifacts immutable (hash-pinned); the historical single failure is NOT a control arm
data_integrity.reproducibility: experiment manifest binds runtime source hash, adapter hash, schema hash, guidance sha256, fixture builder identity and the frozen model config before run 1

execution_boundary: this protocol is a frozen DESIGN; executing it requires an explicit new authorization with real-model budget. Nothing here is an approval to call any provider

fixture.instance_discipline: ONE fresh deterministic instance per ARM per pair (a committed integration mutates the store, so arms never share an instance); cross-instance identity is SEMANTIC (the 2A.3 parity fields: output_tool_schema, projection, model_settings, output_tool_names), not byte identity of run-scoped hashes

invariants_both_arms.adapter: production build_chat_model (unchanged source, hash-pinned at manifest time)

frozen_model_config.sdk_retry_policy: openai SDK client default (OpenAIProvider(base_url, api_key) unchanged construction)

observables.field_name_mismatch: extra_forbidden/missing on the operand/status field names in raw args
observables.invalid_disposition: enum error on disposition, or raw args scan
observables.invalid_question_status: enum error on to_status in the terminal validation details, or raw args scan of the recording proxy
observables.to_status_completed_recurrence: EXPLICIT CHECK: scan every raw response's args for "to_status": "completed" and record per arm

primary.canonical_integration_valid: the stage reached integration_commit with status committed — the ONLY success metric; nothing below it counts as success

metrics.separation_rule: Pydantic improvement != Policy success != Investigation finalization; an arm whose payload only parses better is NOT a policy success; finalization is NOT_EXERCISED in every arm and no incomplete investigation result may be recorded as success

pairing_and_order.rule: for pair i (i=1..4): prepare control instance, run control; prepare treatment instance, run treatment; never reorder, never skip, never re-run

pre_call_gates.DIAGNOSTICS_READY: deterministic FunctionModel invalid-output through BOTH arms -> RCA-1 sink with observable stage/schema_hash/tool_name/validation_error_details, 0600 permissions, zero real model calls
pre_call_gates.INPUT_IDENTITY_PASS: per pair: semantic parity of both instances' captured model-visible input (2A.3 field discipline)
pre_call_gates.PROMPT_DIFF_PASS: treatment instructions == control instructions + \n\n + guidance(GUIDANCE sha e00c1549284c…) exactly
pre_call_gates.SCHEMA_UNCHANGED: output-tool schema hash == a214ec4f5e81fcbb in both arms and equal to the frozen RCA-2A.4 manifest

provider_capacity_gate.requirement: CAPACITY_PREFLIGHT_PASS + identity exact on every probe, BEFORE pair 1

sample_counts.derivation: retry budget 1 -> at most 2 requests per stage invocation
sample_counts.no_dynamic_increase: the sample count is frozen here; results may NEVER be used to justify adding pairs

stop_conditions: any stage invocation raises an exception class outside {UnexpectedModelBehavior, APITimeoutError}
never add pairs after seeing results
